overview_description.description: Torq provides an AI-driven security hyperautomation platform that enables organizations to automate detection, investigation, prioritization, and response to cybersecurity threats without extensive manual intervention. Its products include Torq Hyperautomation for building no-code/low-code security workflows, Torq HyperSOC for orchestrating autonomous security operations, and a suite of AI agents that assist with alert triage and case management. The platform connects to security tool stacks to streamline complex processes, trigger automated responses, and reduce alert noise for security operations teams. Torq’s technology emphasizes natural language-driven automation and integration across security systems to accelerate remediation and operational efficiency.

about_short_description.short_description: Torq is an AI-first no-code automation platform that unifies and automates workflows and processes across modern enterprise security.

product.name: Torq AI SOC Platform
product.description: An AI-driven security operations platform that manages the threat lifecycle from alert triage and investigation through response, remediation, and case closure.

product.name: Socrates
product.description: An AI SOC analyst that uses natural language to plan investigations, coordinate specialized agents, manage cases, and execute security remediation.

product.name: Torq Hyperautomation™
product.description: A security workflow automation platform that connects enterprise tools and executes cross-system processes using configurable workflows, APIs, webhooks, and AI agents.

product.name: Torq HyperAgents™
product.description: A set of autonomous, transparent, and customizable AI agents for investigating alerts, gathering evidence, coordinating actions, and automating security operations workflows.

product.name: Auto Triage
product.description: An agentic alert-triage engine that normalizes, correlates, deduplicates, enriches, and prioritizes security events to distinguish actionable threats from false positives.

product.name: Torq Case Management
product.description: A security case-management capability that provides a centralized view of alerts, evidence, timelines, assignments, summaries, collaboration, and response actions.
